history.summary: A 710 sqft 2BR at Dairy Farm Residences, a 2023-TOP D23 (Hillview/Bukit Panjang) 99yr mixed development, at $1.17M / $1,648 psf vs a $1,790 project median. Low quantum and below-median pricing are attractive, but a negative resale-only trend, 1.12km/13-min MRT walk, and incoming nearby supply weigh on it.
history.rating_rationale: The deciding tension: the listing's $1,648 psf is ~8% below the $1,790 project median (research confirms 12-month avg ~$1,839 psf) — so this is priced attractively for the project, and the $1.17M quantum is highly liquid. But the resale-only CAGR is negative (-1.23%) with a new_launch_bias flag and score_1000 of 350, signalling the project's resale prices have softened off launch highs — a real concern for a 2023-TOP development. Web research flags incoming supply (Narra Residences ~540 units Q1 2026 + another ~480-unit GLS site on Dairy Farm Walk), which will compete on resale. Offsetting: 2BR is the widest-pool format and the entry is sub-$1.2M and below median. The cheap entry roughly balances the soft trend and supply overhang — Neutral.
red_flags: Negative resale-only CAGR (-1.2%) — prices softened off launch
Incoming nearby supply (Narra ~540 units + ~480-unit GLS) will compete on resale
1.12km / 13-min walk to Hillview MRT — not a true MRT-adjacent unit
catalysts: Listed ~8% below project median PSF; cheap sub-$1.2M entry
2BR — widest tenant and resale buyer pool
Mixed development with retail (HillV2-area amenities); low-density Dairy Farm enclave

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: 2BR in a mixed development draws steady demand from the Bukit Panjang/Hillview catchment, but the area is not a prime rental node; yield around 3%, occupancy decent.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Negative resale-only trend and a fresh wave of nearby new supply cap near-term upside; the new_launch_bias flag means the blended 1.7% figure is optimistic. The below-median entry provides some downside cushion but no clear growth driver.
